summary.lead: The 4th year undergraduate students and master's students graduated.

overview: Graduation and degree conferment ceremonies were held for the fourth-year undergraduate students and second-year master's students in the class of 2024! Congratulations to all graduates! We wish you great success on your new path, building on the knowledge and experiences you gained at Ritsumeikan☺
